description:
This endpoint creates or updates a batch of Line Item Types.
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

id.description: Unique identifier for this Line Item Type (cost type). Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete it via /rest/v1.0/line_item_types/{id}.

name.description: Human-readable name of the Line Item Type, such as "Labor" or "Equipment".

code.description: Short abbreviation code for the Line Item Type, used in CSV imports and cost reports to reference this type.

base_type.description: Underlying cost category this Line Item Type maps to, which determines how associated costs are classified.

origin_data.description: Free-form data carried over from the external system of record (such as an ERP) this Line Item Type originated from. Null when the Line Item Type was not created through an external integration.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this Line Item Type in the external system of record (such as an ERP). Null when the Line Item Type was not created through an external integration.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns the Line Item Types being synced.

updates.description: Line Item Types to create or update in this batch. An entry with a matching id (or origin_id) is updated; an entry without one is created.

id.description: ID of an existing Line Item Type to update. Omit to create a new Line Item Type.

name.description: Human-readable name of the Line Item Type.

csv_import_code.description: Short abbreviation code for the Line Item Type, used in CSV imports and cost reports.

base_type.description: Underlying cost category this Line Item Type maps to, which determines how associated costs are classified.

origin_data.description: Free-form data from the external system of record (such as an ERP) this Line Item Type originated from.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this Line Item Type in the external system of record (such as an ERP). Can be used in place of id to match an existing Line Item Type.
